game.title: Khasai
game.description: A traditional marble game played by children, using small glass or clay marbles, requiring precision and strategic shooting skills.
equipment: Small hole or circle drawn on ground
howToPlay: Step 1: Draw a small circle on flat ground and place several marbles inside.
Step 2: Players take turns shooting their 'shooter' marble from outside the circle.
Step 3: The goal is to knock marbles out of the circle while keeping the shooter inside.
Step 4: If a player knocks a marble out, they keep it and take another turn.
Step 5: If the shooter rolls outside the circle, the turn passes to the next player.
Step 6: Players must use their thumb to flick the shooter with precision.
Step 7: Advanced players develop techniques like backspin and curve shots.
Step 8: The game ends when all marbles are cleared from the circle.
Step 9: The player with the most marbles collected wins.
Step 10: Marbles are often traded and collected as prized possessions.
